completeProfile.name: Eldritch Blast
completeProfile.castingAbility: CHA; both feat grants share this one source ability/identity, not two selectable histories.
completeProfile.effect: Make one spell attack for 1d10 force. Explicit total-character-level scaling supplies 2 beams at 5,3 at 11,4 at 17; declare each target before its attack, each must be perceived within 60 ft/line of effect. Different legal recipients allowed; each beam is a separate hit/damage event. Ordinary critical doubles that beam’s die only. No CHA damage modifier, pushing or automatic extra effect. Normal cantrip RP 0, actual independent costs, Dissonance/Refrain and interruption apply once for the cast, not once per beam. No generic ordinary catalog access or Warlock class is inferred.
completeProfile.grant: Forbidden Pact or Eldritch Echo supplies one actual cantrip spellcasting route. Duplicate grant creates no duplicate spell, price waiver, resource pool, known-spell count or separate Refrain.
